_doc: Wandering pack routes for Torbor Downs — made by tools/content-packs.mjs from the bake (do not edit by hand; re-run it after a re-bake, last in the content chain). Read by js/sim/packs.js. Each route: zone, kind (road | shore | valley | open | cross), loop (false = there and back), pts (world metres), rests (waypoint indices where the pack stops), length (one lap, metres), zones it passes through, comps {composition id: weight} that may walk it, noLead (compositions that walk it with no leader: the zone has none of that leader's kind).
